features.desc: 새 로고 에셋: docs/renewal/brand/itmoss-logo-source.png(밝은 배경, 잎 마크 #257833 + 워드마크 #151F1D)에서 ImageMagick 스크립트 scripts/make-logo.sh 로 배경 제거·변환 → public/images/brand/ logo-on-light.webp(원색) · logo-on-dark.webp(워드마크만 --color-paper 계열로, 마크 녹색 유지) · logo-mark.webp(마크만) · favicon-32.png · apple-touch-icon.png(180) + manifest.json(파일별 width/height)
features.check: cd public/images/brand && for f in logo-on-light.webp logo-on-dark.webp logo-mark.webp favicon-32.png apple-touch-icon.png manifest.json; do test -s $f || exit 1; done && for f in logo-on-light.webp logo-on-dark.webp logo-mark.webp; do magick $f -format '%[opaque]' info: | grep -q False || exit 1; test $(wc -c < $f) -le 307200 || exit 1; done && test "$(magick favicon-32.png -format '%wx%h' info:)" = 32x32 && test "$(magick apple-touch-icon.png -format '%wx%h' info:)" = 180x180 && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('manifest.json'));assert all(e.get('width') and e.get('height') for e in d['files'])" && test $(magick logo-on-dark.webp -fx 'u.a>0.5&&u.r>0.8&&u.g>0.8&&u.b>0.8' -alpha off -format '%[fx:mean*w*h]' info: | cut -d. -f1) -gt 500 && for f in logo-on-dark.webp logo-on-light.webp logo-mark.webp; do test $(magick $f -fx 'u.a>0.5&&abs(u.r-0.145)<0.12&&abs(u.g-0.47)<0.12&&abs(u.b-0.2)<0.12' -alpha off -format '%[fx:mean*w*h]' info: | cut -d. -f1) -gt 500 || exit 1; done && test $(magick logo-on-light.webp -fx 'u.a>0.5&&u.r<0.15&&u.g<0.2&&u.b<0.2' -alpha off -format '%[fx:mean*w*h]' info: | cut -d. -f1) -gt 500 && test $(magick logo-mark.webp -fx 'u.a>0.5&&u.r<0.2&&u.g<0.2&&u.b<0.2' -alpha off -format '%[fx:mean*w*h]' info: | cut -d. -f1) -eq 0 && test $(magick logo-mark.webp -format '%w' info:) -lt $(magick logo-on-light.webp -format '%w' info:) && python3 -c "import json,subprocess;d=json.load(open('manifest.json'));assert all(subprocess.run(['magick',e['file'],'-format','%wx%h','info:'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout==f\"{e['width']}x{e['height']}\" for e in d['files'])"
features.notes: 완료 2026-10-13: WEAK 보강: check 에 마크 녹색 유지(dark/light/mark)·logo-mark 에 글자 없음·mark 폭<전체·manifest 크기 실측 일치 추가. 산출물 변경 없음
